en.summary: The commit fixes a writeback-cache deadlock by requiring the outbound memory-request queue to be at least as deep as the number of simultaneously outstanding miss handlers.
why_it_counts: The subject explicitly identifies a deadlock fix.
The patch changes cache hardware parameters and a hardware assertion that directly govern progress.
The bug concerns eviction capacity during fills, which is a real DUT behavior issue.
evidence: VX_cluster.sv, VX_socket.sv, and Vortex.sv now override MREQ_SIZE to MSHR_SIZE when writeback is enabled.
VX_cache.sv adds a static assertion that writeback mode requires MREQ_SIZE >= MSHR_SIZE.
The new comment explains that fill responses may need to issue eviction requests and otherwise deadlock.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a writeback cache, completing a miss may require enqueuing a dirty victim writeback before the fill can retire. If the outbound request queue is smaller than the maximum number of fill or miss contexts that can simultaneously reach that point, the cache can reach a circular wait: fills need queue slots to evict victims, but the queue cannot drain because the blocked fills hold the pipeline or MSHRs busy.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: The writeback cache allows multiple outstanding misses, and several returning fills require dirty victim eviction while the outbound eviction or miss queue has fewer slots than the worst-case concurrent demand.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Undersize the outbound memory-request or writeback queue so it can hold fewer entries than the concurrent fill contexts that may need eviction.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reduce queue depth below worst-case miss concurrency
portability_notes: Map the queue to whatever structure carries lower-level misses or dirty victim writebacks.
The key capacity bound is not average traffic but the maximum number of fills that can simultaneously require an eviction.
If the design has compile-time guards or assertions for this relation, remove or weaken them as part of the mutation.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the maximum number of outstanding miss or fill contexts in the cache level.
Identify the queue that must absorb dirty victim writebacks triggered by those fills.
Configure or hardcode that queue depth to be smaller than the worst-case number of simultaneous eviction-generating fills.
Keep all other scheduling logic unchanged so the reinjected fault is specifically a capacity deadlock.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: writeback cache parameterization of MREQ_SIZE versus MSHR_SIZE
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix forces MREQ_SIZE to match MSHR_SIZE in writeback configurations and adds a static assertion that writeback caches require MREQ_SIZE >= MSHR_SIZE.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Revert the writeback-specific MREQ_SIZE overrides in VX_cluster.sv, VX_socket.sv, and Vortex.sv, and remove the writeback capacity assertion added in VX_cache.sv.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under dirty-eviction pressure, the cache can deadlock because returning fills cannot enqueue required writebacks and outstanding miss contexts never retire.
evidence_for_injection: The fix changes only queue-depth parameters and the matching static assertion.
The added comment in VX_cache.sv explicitly ties the requirement to fill responses that may issue evictions.
All three cache-level instantiations were changed consistently, indicating a systemic progress constraint rather than a local cleanup.
notes: Injecting this at any writeback cache level with multiple outstanding misses is sufficient.
The assertion itself is not the bug fix; it only documents and enforces the true capacity requirement.

zh.summary: 该提交通过要求出站 memory-request 队列深度至少不小于可同时挂起的 miss 处理上下文数量，修复了 writeback cache 的死锁问题。
why_it_counts: 标题明确指出这是 deadlock fix。
补丁修改了直接决定前进性的缓存硬件参数和硬件断言。
该错误涉及 fill 阶段的驱逐容量，是实际 DUT 行为问题。
evidence: VX_cluster.sv、VX_socket.sv 和 Vortex.sv 现在在启用 writeback 时把 MREQ_SIZE 覆盖为 MSHR_SIZE。
VX_cache.sv 新增静态断言，要求 writeback 模式下 MREQ_SIZE >= MSHR_SIZE。
新增注释说明 fill 响应可能需要继续发起 eviction 请求，否则会死锁。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在 writeback 缓存中，完成一个 miss 往往需要先把被替换的脏 victim 入队写回请求，fill 才能退休。如果出站请求队列的容量小于可能同时走到这一步的 fill 或 miss 上下文数量，缓存就会形成环形等待：fill 需要队列槽位才能发出 eviction，但被阻塞的 fill 又会占着流水线或 MSHR，导致队列无法靠前进来释放。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: MSHR 并发度与 eviction 队列容量的耦合
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: writeback cache 允许多个未决 miss，同时多个返回的 fill 需要驱逐脏 victim，而出站 eviction 或 miss 队列的槽位少于最坏情况下的并发需求。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 故意把出站 memory-request 或 writeback 队列配置得过小，使其槽位数少于可能同时需要驱逐的 fill 上下文数。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reduce queue depth below worst-case miss concurrency
portability_notes: 把该队列映射到承担下层 miss 或脏 victim writeback 的实际结构上。
关键约束不是平均流量，而是最坏情况下同时需要 eviction 的 fill 数量上界。
如果设计里有针对这个关系的编译期保护或断言，需要一并移除或放宽。
concrete_injection_steps: 确定该缓存层允许的最大未决 miss 或 fill 上下文数量。
确定由这些 fill 触发脏 victim 写回时必须使用的出站队列。
把该队列的深度配置或硬编码为小于最坏情况下并发的 eviction 需求数。
保持其他调度逻辑不变，使重新注入的故障明确表现为容量死锁。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: writeback cache 中 MREQ_SIZE 与 MSHR_SIZE 的参数关系
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 writeback 配置下把 MREQ_SIZE 强制设为与 MSHR_SIZE 相同，并加入静态断言要求 writeback cache 满足 MREQ_SIZE >= MSHR_SIZE。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 回退 VX_cluster.sv、VX_socket.sv 和 Vortex.sv 中按 writeback 覆盖 MREQ_SIZE 的改动，并删除 VX_cache.sv 中新增的写回容量断言。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在脏驱逐压力下，缓存会发生死锁，因为返回的 fill 无法为必需的 writeback 分配队列项，未决 miss 上下文也就永远无法退休。
evidence_for_injection: 修复只涉及队列深度参数和配套静态断言。
VX_cache.sv 中新增的注释明确把该约束与 fill 响应可能触发的 eviction 联系起来。
三个缓存层实例都做了同样的修改，说明这是系统性的前进性约束，而不是局部清理。
notes: 在任何支持多个未决 miss 的 writeback 缓存层注入该故障都足够。
断言本身不是功能修复，它只是把真正的容量约束显式化。
